records.name: Fleet device posture
records.content:
# Machine posture comes from the LDAP zprMachine schema.
define SecureFleetLaptops as a device with redwood.machine_type:laptop.
define RemoteFleetDevices as a device with redwood.location:Remote.
define SecureDevices as a device with redwood.secure:TRUE.
define FleetSafety as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:fleet-safety.

service FleetSafety as json {"service_class":"FleetSafety","actor_cn":"fleet-safety","summary":"Illustrative fleet safety service.","endpoint":"zpr://fleet-safety","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow SecureDevices.
records.summary: Device type, location, and secure status predicates

records.name: Fleet operator access
records.content:
# User LDAP attributes require an AuthService user.sub identity.
define FleetManagers as a user with user.role:FleetManagers.
define RouteExchange as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:route-exchange.

service RouteExchange as json {"service_class":"RouteExchange","actor_cn":"route-exchange","summary":"Illustrative route exchange service.","endpoint":"zpr://route-exchange","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow FleetManagers.
records.summary: User role-group access to route coordination

records.name: Partner auditor access
records.content:
define PartnerAuditors as a user with user.role:PartnerAuditors.
define ShipmentLedger as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:shipment-ledger.

service ShipmentLedger as json {"service_class":"ShipmentLedger","actor_cn":"shipment-ledger","summary":"Illustrative shipment ledger.","endpoint":"zpr://shipment-ledger","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow PartnerAuditors.
records.summary: Partner role-group access to shipment records
